notes: The first isnad opens with the passive «وقد روي عن» and names no one before Hisham, so it is read as starting at Hisham. The second isnad comes after the matn and carries the same saying («نحوه بمعناه»), so it is a route, not a variant. «عن أبيه» is bare, so it is a relation link. The grading remark «حسن صحيح» is left out.
